QuestInfo.name: An Uneasy Truce
QuestInfo.0: #b#p438##k is ready to send the guild's offer to the fairies.
QuestInfo.1: I need to bring the #b#p411##k's offer and #b#t4031145##k to #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p702##k got his scrolls back and accepted the truce for the Hollow. #b#p437##k will speak for the guild, and #b#p438##k and her friends will keep watch over the route into the Hollow.

0.0: Here's the deal. The guild trades with the fairies, and there's no raid. #b#p437##k speaks for the guild, and my friends and I keep watch on the route.
0.1: Someone has to bring the offer to the fairies, and it can't be a thief. Will you take it to #b#p702##k? And here. His scrolls, and his tongs. Please give them back for me.

yes.0: Thank you. For everything. #bPerry#k is holding on. That's enough for now.

no.0: Take your time. But the #b#p411##k won't wait forever.

1.0: My scrolls! And my good tongs! Where did you... Oh. Thieves from Kerning City.
1.1: And they want to trade, not steal? ...After everything, I didn't expect an offer.
1.2: Very well. Tell them the Hollow accepts. #b#p700##k will grumble about it for a month, but we will trade fairly, and their lookouts are welcome at the Forgotten Entrance.
1.3: Trusting them is a risk. But you have earned that trust for them. Thank you. Please, take this.

npc.0: Please bring the offer and #b#t4031145##k to #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k.

item.0: Thieves from Kerning City want to trade? ...Then where are my scrolls? Did they keep them after all?

lost.0: You lost them already? ...Fine. I "found" them again. Don't ask how.
